task_label: Implement semantic routine reuse from natural user phrasing
acceptance_criteria: A saved calendar-plus-weather routine can be reused from a later natural calendar-plus-weather request without naming the routine.
Explicit trigger phrase matching remains supported.
Unrelated natural requests do not execute saved routines.
The routine success response says a matching saved routine was used.
task_prompt: Implement TASK-WORKFLOW-M3.4 only. Current behavior: RoutineRunner.execute_by_trigger only matches explicit trigger_phrases via IntentEngine.detect_routine_trigger, so users would need to remember generated names like `Routine List Events`. Required behavior: after a user saves a calendar+weather routine, a later natural request like `Was steht heute in meinem Kalender und wie wird das Wetter in Koeln?` must match the saved routine by bounded semantics/step signature and execute it. Keep explicit trigger matching. Add focused regression tests. Prefer deterministic intent/step-signature matching over embeddings or broad LLM calls. Do not add UI, APIs, transport, OAuth, product OpenRouter, Session-Search, migrations, commits, or dependencies. Return concise JSON-compatible output with status, root_cause, changed_files, command_results, summary, and blockers.
